cards.title: Second Baby: What You Forget the First Time
cards.body: A parent shares honest reflections on having a second child and how much of baby care knowledge fades between kids. From feeding to teeth to diaper changes, the learning curve feels steeper the second time around.

cards.title: Why Reasoning With Upset Children Backfires
cards.body: Emotionally reactive children don't need better explanations—they need you to stop explaining. Your logical reasoning can actually make things worse when they're upset.

cards.title: Is Parental Power Bad When Raising Kids?
cards.body: Experts explore whether using parental authority in child-rearing shows disrespect for children. The debate questions fundamental assumptions about power dynamics in parenting.

cards.title: Four Lessons From Being a Second-Time Mom
cards.body: A parent reflects on the surprises and challenges that come with having a second child. The second time around brings unexpected lessons about parenting you couldn't anticipate.

cards.title: Three Discipline Options When Kids Break Rules
cards.body: Parents have multiple approaches when disciplining children who misbehave. Understanding your options helps you choose the strategy that works best for your family.

cards.title: How Your Father's Depression Affects Your Biology
cards.body: Research shows a father's depression shapes children far deeper than behavior alone. The biological impact begins earlier than previously understood.

cards.title: When Your Adult Child Asks for Money
cards.body: Setting financial boundaries with adult children requires clear language beyond 'I can't afford it.' Better phrasing helps you establish firm limits without guilt.

cards.title: Empty Nest: The Grief Nobody Warns You About
cards.body: Parents share the surprising pain and denial when children leave for university. The emotional impact proves more complicated than simple nostalgia.

cards.title: Life as a Teenage Carer: Hidden Struggles
cards.body: Young carers face significant disadvantages while managing adult responsibilities too early. One teenager reveals the unseen challenges of this demanding role.

cards.title: Childhood Stardom and Addiction Risk
cards.body: Experts warn that child actors face unusually high pressure and substance abuse risks. Access to drugs combined with intense industry pressure creates a dangerous environment.

cards.title: Munchausen by Proxy: A Child's Perspective
cards.body: A son reflects on his mother faking his illness throughout childhood in a Channel 4 documentary. He reveals how she still believes her deceptive actions were justified.
